h2.schema.comment.table.tasks: Main todo task table, separated by task bucket and owner for local personal, player personal, and team tasks.
h2.schema.comment.table.task_tags: Task tag detail table that stores the multi-value relationship between tasks and tags.
h2.schema.comment.table.projects: Project table that stores personal and team project metadata and permission switches.
h2.schema.comment.table.project_members: Team project member table that stores member identity, role, and display name.
h2.schema.comment.table.player_project_s: Player project state table that stores the active project, HUD visibility, and related local state.
h2.schema.comment.table.player_hud_starr: Player HUD starred project table that stores project order when the HUD shows starred projects only.
h2.schema.comment.table.storage_bucket_m: Task storage bucket metadata table that records the last save time for each bucket.
h2.schema.comment.table.storage_meta: Global H2 storage metadata table that records schema version and migration state.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.bucket_ty: Storage bucket type, distinguishing local personal, player personal, team, or project buckets.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.owner_uui: Task bucket owner identifier: local for local buckets, player UUID for player buckets, or team for team buckets.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.scope: Task scope, indicating personal or team task.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.project_i: Project ID that owns the task.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.parent_ta: Parent task ID for a subtask; null indicates a top-level task.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.subtask_s: Order value of a subtask within the same parent; top-level tasks stay at 0.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.title: Task title.
h2.schema.comment.column.tasks.sort_orde: Task order value within the list.
h2.schema.comment.column.task_tags.bucke: Task bucket type that owns the tag.
h2.schema.comment.column.task_tags.owner: Task bucket owner identifier that owns the tag.
h2.schema.comment.column.task_tags.task_: Task ID bound to the tag.
h2.schema.comment.column.task_tags.sort_: Tag order value within the task.
h2.schema.comment.column.projects.bucket: Storage bucket type that owns the project.
h2.schema.comment.column.projects.name: Project name.
h2.schema.comment.column.projects.scope: Project scope, indicating personal or team project.
h2.schema.comment.column.projects.allow_: Whether members may create project tasks.
Whether all players may claim and complete project tasks.
h2.schema.comment.column.projects.sort_o: Project order value within the list.
h2.schema.comment.column.project_members: Project bucket type that owns the member row.
Project ID that owns the member row.
h2.schema.comment.column.player_project_: Currently active project ID for the player.
Whether the player's HUD is visible.
Last saved timestamp for the player's project state.
h2.schema.comment.column.player_hud_star: Player UUID that owns the starred setting.
Bucket type that owns the HUD starred project.
h2.schema.comment.column.storage_bucket_: Task bucket type for this metadata row.
Task bucket owner identifier for this metadata row.
